messages:
Alex: noticed a sudden surge of correctable ECC on ap-sg GPU pool (aps2). latency for inference queues jumped ~3x. investigating, will start drains if noise persists.
Priya: @Alex can you paste nvml/dmesg snippets and rack mapping? curious if it's one chassis or spread.
Alex: snippet from node rack7-42:
```
[2026-03-18T09:02:13Z] GPU0 CORRECTABLE_ECC 142 -> 580 in 10m
[2026-03-18T09:02:15Z] nvml: ecc_scrub: error_recovered=1
[2026-03-18T09:03:01Z] kernel: GPU reset id 31
```
Ryan: seeing same pattern in rack8-03 and rack8-05, all A100S fw v1.12. thermal telemetry shows some GPUs hitting 80-82C pre-spike. could be cooling or a firmware scrub loop.
InfraBot: incident#create severity=medium scope=aps2-gpu-pool affected=service/inference routing=auto-fallback
SRE Oncall: recommend controlled drains of the worst nodes first, staggered to avoid global capacity collapse. shift traffic to eu-west/aps1 as buffer.
Jess: +1. prefer keeping some capacity in each AZ to avoid single-AZ depletion. I'll start extra eu-west spot nodes.
Marcus: ranked nodes by ECC delta: rack7-42, rack8-03, rack8-05, rack7-19, rack6-12, rack9-01. propose draining in that order; start with low-priority jobs.
Alex: kicking drain on rack7-42: `infractl drain node rack7-42 --reason "ECC storm" --evac-mode best-effort`. migration ETA ~4m.
Priya: opening vendor ticket, attaching nvml and dmesg + serials. ticket INC-7591. ask vendor about v1.12 correlation.
Ryan: after drain start, ECC counts on neighbors plateaued but didn't drop. also seeing occasional GPU resets (id 31). power regulator or firmware bug hypothesis.
Jess: spun up +4 eu-west nodes, canary shift 25% traffic now. cost ok for emergency.
InfraBot: deploy#traffic-shift executed: 25%->eu-west; autoscaler provisioned +4 nodes in eu-west.
SRE Oncall: routing policy: prefer region with spare capacity; fallback to dedicated if pool healthy <60%. stagger drains every 10m. suppress noisy alerts for these hosts.
Alex: drain progress rack7-42: 48/50 jobs migrated, 1 pinned job owner notified. will force-evict if >10m.
Marcus: quarantine planned for flagged nodes with tag `ecc-storm-2026-03-18`. schedule 4h replacement window.
Priya: vendor suggests rollback to fw v1.10 as temporary mitigation; RMA expedited but ETA 48h. requesting microcode dumps and two failing serials.
Ryan: propose test rollback on single quarantined node (rack9-01) after snapshot. reboot required. low risk?
Jess: approve one rollback trial on rack9-01 in maintenance window, coordinate with Alex for traffic cushion.
SRE Oncall: suppress console alerts for these nodes to avoid noise. keep incident summary for postmortem.
Alex: queued rollback on rack9-01 in 6m. will report outcome.
InfraBot: alert-suppressed nodes: rack7-42,rack8-03,rack8-05,rack7-19,rack6-12,rack9-01
Alex: update +6m: rollback done on rack9-01, ECC counts dropped 420->8 over 3m, no resets observed. promising.
Priya: vendor to proceed with RMAs for worst nodes; expedited shipping confirmed for two. continue staggered drains and avoid aggressive downscales.
Marcus: starting replacement playbook, confirm chassis swaps and update spare inventory.
Jess: eu-west absorbing 25% shift fine; if >40% we'll need dedicated burst or sales intervention for credits.
SRE Oncall: if shift >30% for >30m, notify customers and #incidents. next status update in 20m.
Alex: logging this thread into the incident doc. plan: continue staggered drains, vendor RMAs, and follow-up postmortem once RMAs complete. thanks all.
